children.name: Megaleledone setebos
children.description: Megaleledone setebos, the giant Antarctic octopus, is a very large venomous octopus with a circum-Antarctic distribution. It grows to at least 28 cm in mantle length and 90 cm in total length. setebos feeds by drilling small holes in large, shelled mollusks, and then injecting its toxic saliva.
